title: Parking within the plot; 2 ECS for 250-300 sqm plots, no per-100sqm norm below 250 sqm (plotted residential, clause viii.a)

output.message: Parking to be provided within the plot. For plots of 250-300 sqm, 2 Equivalent Car Spaces (ECS) are required; for smaller plots no ECS-per-100 sqm norm is specified.

citations.original_text: a. 2 Equivalent Car Space (ECS) in plots of size 250-300sq.m.

notes: Plotted-residential parking (page 154, clause viii). The per-100sqm ECS norm begins at 250 sqm; below that, parking is provided within the plot with no ECS-per-100sqm figure. Replaces the earlier draft that wrongly used the group-housing 2.0 ECS/100sqm norm from page 156.
